name: ai-execution-assistant
description: A deterministic execution assistant for turning intentions into completed work.

scripts.compose:validate: docker compose config --quiet && docker compose -f compose.production-smoke.yaml config --quiet
scripts.container:build: docker build --target runtime -f apps/api/Dockerfile -t execution-assistant-api:local . && docker build --target runtime -f apps/web/Dockerfile -t execution-assistant-web:local .
scripts.postinstall: prisma generate && npm run build --workspace packages/domain && npm run build --workspace packages/contracts
scripts.pilot:rehearse:local: npm run db:migration:rehearse && npm run ops:backup-restore:rehearse && npm run pilot:resource-baseline && npm run container:smoke
scripts.pilot:resource-baseline: npm run db:migrate:test && npm run build --workspace @execution/api && tsx scripts/run-pilot-resource-baseline.ts
scripts.test:integration: npm run db:migrate:test && npm run test:integration --workspaces --if-present
scripts.verify: npm run db:validate && npm run format:check && npm run security:matrix && npm run security:secrets && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:integration && npm run build && npm run compose:validate
